articles.summary: LITTLE ROCK, Ark., April 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bank OZK (the “Bank”) (Nasdaq: OZK) today announced that net income available to common stockholders for the first quarter of 2026 was $159.3 million, a 5.1% decrease from $167.9 million for the first quarter of 2025.
articles.title: Bank OZK Announces First Quarter 2026 Earnings
